mapper.select: SELECT cache_key, feature, prompt_version, result_json, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, hit_count, created_at FROM ai_result_cache WHERE cache_key = #{cacheKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_result_cache (cache_key, feature, prompt_version, result_json, model, input_tokens, output_tokens) VALUES (#{cacheKey}, #{feature}, #{promptVersion}, #{resultJson}, #{model}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}) ON CONFLICT (cache_key) DO UPDATE SET result_json = EXCLUDED.result_json, model = EXCLUDED.model, input_tokens = EXCLUDED.input_tokens, output_tokens = EXCLUDED.output_tokens, hit_count = 0, created_at = NOW()
